title: Phyfold: environment aware mathematical modeling for protein folding dynamics integrated with physics informed neural network.
authors: Ul Rahman, Jamshaid; Noureen, Iqra; Mannan, Abdul; Uwitije, Rongin
one_liner_zh: 该文提出PhyFold，将反应扩散方程与物理信息神经网络及ProtT5序列嵌入结合，实现环境依赖的蛋白质折叠动力学建模，是对静态结构预测向动态物理一致模拟的扩展，与蛋白质结构计算课题高度相关。
abstract: Protein folding remains a fundamental problem in computational biology, where understanding folding trajectories and dynamic behavior under physiological conditions is critical for linking structure to function. Recent advances such as AlphaFold have revolutionized sequence to structure prediction, establishing a powerful and robust foundation for computational protein modeling. Building upon this success, we introduce a novel physics informed computational framework that expands static structure prediction toward dynamic and physically consistent modeling of protein folding processes. The proposed framework unifies a mathematically grounded reaction diffusion model of folding kinetics with deep sequence embeddings through a physics informed neural network (PINN), ensuring consistency with governing physical laws while remaining biologically grounded. We refer to this unified framework as PhyFold. Our results illustrate that the proposed approach effectively captures environment dependent folding dynamics and shows strong agreement with both numerical reference solutions and experimental fluorescence measurements under physiologically relevant conditions. By explicitly integrating environmental factors such as temperature, pressure, and pH, PhyFold enables realistic, physics aware simulation of protein folding dynamics. This approach offers a natural extension of modern structure prediction methods and opens new directions for protein design, structure guided drug discovery, and personalized medicine. The code to reproduce the work is available at https://github.com/jamshaidwarraich/PhyFold.git .Scientific contributionPhyFold introduces a hybrid Bio-Physics Informed Neural Network framework that models protein folding kinetics as a reaction diffusion partial differential equation with environmentally modulated kinetic coefficients, integrated with ProtT5 sequence embeddings for sequence specific spatiotemporal prediction an approach not previously demonstrated in the literature. Unlike purely data driven or static structure prediction methods, PhyFold explicitly encodes temperature, pH, and pressure dependence into governing kinetic coefficients, enabling physically interpretable simulation of cooperative folding transitions across diverse physiological conditions. Dual validation against finite difference reference solutions and experimental GFP fluorescence measurements confirms mathematical consistency and biological relevance, establishing PhyFold as a computationally efficient surrogate for environment aware protein folding dynamics.
abstract_zh: 蛋白质折叠仍然是计算生物学中的一个基本问题，理解生理条件下的折叠轨迹和动态行为对于将结构连接至功能至关重要。AlphaFold等近期进展彻底改变了从序列到结构的预测，为计算蛋白质建模建立了强大而稳健的基础。在此成功之上，我们引入了一种新颖的物理信息计算框架，将静态结构预测扩展至蛋白质折叠过程的动态和物理一致性建模。所提出的框架通过物理信息神经网络（PINN）将折叠动力学的数学基础反应扩散模型与深度序列嵌入统一起来，确保与主导物理定律的一致性，同时保持生物学基础。我们将此统一框架称为PhyFold。我们的结果表明，所提出的方法有效捕捉了环境依赖的折叠动力学，并在生理相关条件下与数值参考解和实验荧光测量均表现出强烈一致性。通过明确整合温度、压力和pH等环境因素，PhyFold实现了蛋白质折叠动力学的现实、物理感知模拟。该方法为现代结构预测方法提供了自然扩展，并为蛋白质设计、结构引导的药物发现和个性化医学开辟了新方向。复现本工作的代码可在 https://github.com/jamshaidwarraich/PhyFold.git 获取。科学贡献PhyFold引入了一种混合生物物理信息神经网络框架，将蛋白质折叠动力学建模为具有环境调制动力学系数的反应扩散偏微分方程，并与ProtT5序列嵌入集成，用于序列特异性时空预测，这种方法在文献中尚未有先例。与纯数据驱动或静态结构预测方法不同，PhyFold明确将温度、pH和压力依赖性编码到控制动力学系数中，使得在不同生理条件下对协同折叠转变进行物理可解释的模拟成为可能。通过有限差分参考解和实验GFP荧光测量的双重验证，确认了数学一致性和生物学相关性，确立了PhyFold作为环境感知蛋白质折叠动力学的计算高效替代模型。
